answer: Like a stepped terrace carving vitality into steep mountains, an agent network organizes trust through layered crystallization. Each autonomous identity crystallizes as a verifiable graph vertex, where minting consensus influence requires staking bonded validation history. An attacker trying to forge thousands of false identities faces superlinear collateral scaling: duplicating a peer cannot mimic the hardened mineral purity of an ancient jade seal, making mass subversion economically ruinous.
